nodes.text:
"What are the symptoms? 🩺

Fever 🤒 

Cough 😪

Fatigue 😫

Breathing difficulties 🤧🤢

How does it spread?
Through respiratory droplets, much like the flu or COVID-19. Avoiding crowded places can reduce risk." https://t.co/OWtJ6OgjDA

"Why is this concerning?
Hospitals in China are reportedly overwhelmed due to the rapid spread. The strain on healthcare systems is reminiscent of early COVID-19 days."📝 https://t.co/Al2CkMwMON
